definitions.explanation: The act of collecting payments or fees owed. Refers to going around to collect money from customers, members, or residents, or to the system of having payments collected at one's door.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{集金|しゅうきん}{担当|たんとう}が{回|まわ}ってくる。
examples.english: The bill collector comes around every month.

examples.japanese: NHKの{受信料|じゅしんりょう}の{集金|しゅうきん}が{来|き}たが、{留守|るす}だった。
examples.english: The NHK fee collector came, but nobody was home.

notes:
Refers to the practice of collecting payments by visiting homes or businesses in person. In Japan, this is especially associated with NHK subscription fee collectors and newspaper subscription collectors who go door to door.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集金|しゅうきん}に{来|く}る: to come to collect payment
- {集金|しゅうきん}に{回|まわ}る: to go around collecting money
- {集金|しゅうきん}{担当|たんとう}: person in charge of collection
- {集金|しゅうきん}{業務|ぎょうむ}: collection work/duties
- {集金|しゅうきん}{袋|ぶくろ}: collection envelope

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徴収|ちょうしゅう}: collection (more formal/official, often used for taxes and fees)
- {回収|かいしゅう}: recovery, retrieval (broader meaning including collecting objects)
